title: Term Life Insurance Returned Items Charged: Owner's Standing with Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance
content:
In a grace remittance on a Term Life Insurance policy, which returned items are charged is chosen by the owner's standing with Ashgrove — whether the owner holds an in-force Whole Life Insurance or Universal Life Insurance policy — and by the payments returned unpaid on the policy in the 12 months ending today:

1. The owner holds an in-force Ashgrove whole life or universal life policy, and at least one payment was returned in those 12 months: **only the most recent returned item** is charged.
2. The owner holds neither, and 3 or more payments were returned in those 12 months: **every returned item except the first of the 12 months** is charged.
3. Otherwise: **every returned item of the 12 months** is charged.

| Owner holds in-force whole life or universal life | Returns in the 12 months | Items charged |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 0 | none (there are no returned items) |
| yes | 1, 2, 3 or more | 1 |
| no | 3 or more | the count less 1 |
| no | 1 or 2 | all of them |

Hypothetical: an owner with no in-force permanent policy and 4 returns in the 12 months is charged for 3 items; the same owner holding an in-force Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 is charged for 1.
